message: Designer is checking the furniture layout

The sage sofa works well with the supplied palette, though the floor’s colour and material aren’t shown in the scene data, so I can’t confirm that pairing specifically.

The sandy-beige rug and warm ivory walls soften the sage; walnut and oak tones add warmth, while terracotta and brass provide earthy accents. Overall, it’s a calm, cohesive palette.

One optional small improvement: a slightly lighter, cream-toned rug would give the sofa more definition. Nothing has been changed.
